parsed.name: LightField科研探测相机
parsed.description: 用于科研实验的面阵探测相机/探测器，可采集二维图像或光谱相关信号，常见于光谱测量、低光成像和实验室光学检测。
parsed.description_en: A scientific area detector camera used to acquire 2D images or spectroscopy-related signals, commonly used in laboratory optical measurements, low-light imaging, and spectroscopic experiments.
